description: Why Join Us? We have a clear, high-impact vision with a solid project structure. If you want to work on a pitch-ready idea with a passionate team, this is the place!
summary: Our project is about the climate change, the changes in our environment and its effect on humans. Our group also mentioned the microplastics in the presentation. As we mentioned the effects of climate change on humans, we also mentioned the human effects on climate change. We presented solutions, the changes and how this changes affect our world. We strongly supported the idea of green tomorrows.
details: We focused on climate change and its effect on humanity.
